about.title: About
about.body:
All-In-One Finder {version}

Acknowledgements
Thanks to all contributors. Without your contributions, this finder would not exist.
UI Author: SunnySlopes, inspired by SlimeFinderGUI, author: Bot_City
Map display: https://github.com/xpple/cubiomes, authors: Cubitect, xpple
Low-Y Swamp Hut: https://github.com/M33Galaxy/LowYSwampHut, authors: M33_Galaxy, SunnySlopes
River: https://github.com/SunnySlopes/RiverFinderGUI,
https://github.com/Melationin/RiverFinder, authors: Ruo_Mo, SunnySlopes
Low-Y Dripstone Cave and Large-Pit Low-Y Dripstone Cave: https://github.com/SunnySlopes/LowYDripstoneCaveFinderGUI, author: SunnySlopes
Slime Chunks: https://github.com/CITYWIDESIGN/SlimeRadar,
https://github.com/CITYWIDESIGN/SlimeOptimizer, author: Bot_City
Double Ocean Monument: https://github.com/SunnySlopes/DoubleMonumentForFixedSeed, author: SunnySlopes
Multi Ocean Monument: https://github.com/Whisperlyric/MultiMonumentFinder, authors: Whisperlyric, SunnySlopes
Nether Fortress Crossroads, Nether Fortress Large Range: https://github.com/SunnySlopes/FortressFinderGUI, author: SunnySlopes
Trial Spawner: https://github.com/qk-yiyihehe/trial-spawner-native, authors: qk-yiyihehe
Budding Amethyst: https://github.com/qk-yiyihehe/geode-native, authors: qk-yiyihehe
All Flower Farm Searcher: https://github.com/SunnySlopes/FlowerFinderGUI, author: SunnySlopes
The Low-Y Dripstone Cave Searcher and All Flower Farm Searcher also guided by M33_Galaxy.

search.unsupported: This search does not support the selected version.

map.parseHint: /tp x y z, or x z, or (x, z) / (x, y, z)
map.badParse: Could not parse that coordinate text.
map.badSession: Could not read that session file.
map.trialNotGenerated: No chamber generated at this position

error.save-failed: Save failed: cannot write to the selected location. Try another folder.
error.bad-bounds: The window size is invalid. Change them between 0 and 512.
error.area-too-large: The search box is larger than the allowed maximum.
error.unsupported-version: This version is not supported by the search.
error.out-of-memory: The search ran out of memory.
error.bad-ratio: The area ratio is outside the allowed range.
error.slime-start-failed: The slime search could not start.
error.witch-start-failed: The low-Y swamp hut search could not start.
error.flower-start-failed: The flower farm search could not start.
error.trial-start-failed: The trial spawner search could not start.
error.river-start-failed: The river search could not start.
error.search-start-failed: The search thread could not start.
error.unsupported-preset: This preset is not supported by the search.
error.native: The native engine is not connected.
error.range-too-large: Search area is too large; shrink it or use the multi-monument search.
error.bad-span-edge: Span long/short edge must be between 0 and 260.
error.bad-span-height: Span minimum height must be between 0 and 40.
error.bad-monument-area: Minimum usable area must be between 6728 and 13455.
error.fortress-start-failed: Failed to start the nether fortress search.
error.multi-monument-start-failed: Failed to start the multi-monument search.
error.double-monument-start-failed: Failed to start the double-monument search.
error.geode-start-failed: Budding Amethyst search failed to start.
error.geode-verify-failed: Exact verification failed for a point (it stays unverified).
error.full-map-single-seed: Full map search supports a single seed only.

dripstonecave.helpCave: Search low-Y dripstone cave and river combinations in the given bounds. Supports single seed and seed lists.
dripstonecave.helpPit: Large-pit low-Y dripstone fast search. Single seed only.
dripstonecave.tryLuck: Hey! The seed you typed in could be a lucky one, would you like to try newly released fast search instead to get results with only 1% to 5% of the original time?
dripstonecave.stay: don't cheat me! remain on this page
dripstonecave.unlikely: Hey! The seed you typed in looks not so lucky. Fast search will probably find nothing. Go back to the first tab and use the normal search?
dripstonecave.toRiver: The cave search area is too small and may find nothing. Do you want to go to the river search tab?

pitStage.3: Phase 3 precise check of candidate points

dripstonecave.ratio90: This area exceeds 20000001×20000001, so the cave ratio must be at least 90%; it has been set to 90%.

slime.help: Searches for the AFK point with the largest slime spawning area inside the player's spawn ring. The minimum slime area is automatically converted to a slime chunk count using the built-in thresholds.
slime.areaClamped: The minimum slime area must be between 9000 and 15000. It has been adjusted to {min}.
slime.tooMany: The search area is large for this minimum slime area and may produce too many results. Consider raising the minimum slime area to at least {min}.

lowyswamphut.help: After entering block coordinates, the search aligns them to 512-block regions and expands the bounds to whole regions. Large biomes follow the map checkbox (that preset approximates the depth dimension).
lowyswamphut.lowYWarning: The selected height is too low for a single-seed to come out anything. Change it to -40?

river.help: Searches for the location with the largest river area inside the player's spawn ring. With "Count cave area" enabled, cave area counts toward the total area the same way river area does.
river.filtered: At most 1000 results are kept, sorted by score.
river.toCave: The river search area is very large and will lead to slow search and too many results. Do you want to switch to cave search to get higher efficiency?

fortress.crossHelp: Finds 2/3/4-crossing layouts in soul sand valleys.
fortress.spanHelp: Finds nether fortresses whose large-range long/short edges and height all exceed the required minimums.

monument.help: Only triple or quadruple monuments; the area inside a single player's AFK range must exceed the threshold.

double.help: Always searches full-efficiency double monuments, so only small areas are supported.
double.lowHint: Low-efficiency pairs are sorted last and dropped first.

flower.simulationDistanceHint: Simulation distance (8-32): the window long side becomes 32 × distance + 16 (capped at 1024) and the window switches to square
flower.badSimulationDistance: Simulation distance must be an integer from 8 to 32.
flower.help: Finds assigned size windows with flower forest, swamp and pale garden(1.21.4+) in given area.

trial.simulationDistanceHint: Simulation distance (8–16): sets the long side to 32×distance+16 (max 512) and switches to a square window.
trial.badSimulationDistance: Simulation distance must be an integer from 8 to 32.
trial.strictMarginHint: Strict mode: a chamber origin must stay at least this many blocks inside the statistics window; edge chambers count toward neither structures nor spawners.
trial.badStrictMargin: The edge margin must be smaller than half the window; reduce it or enlarge the statistics window.
trial.windowTooLarge: The statistics window cannot exceed 512×512 (equivalent area limit {area} blocks²).
trial.structuresCapHint: The linked-chamber cap is fixed at 4 (double/triple/quadruple); min chambers must be 1–4.
trial.badStructures: The linked-chamber cap is 4: min chambers must be between 1 and 4.
trial.conversionRatioHint: Range 0–1 inclusive; out-of-range values are adjusted automatically.
trial.help: In square/rect mode edit the long/short side; in circle mode only the radius is used. Side max 512, circle radius max 256. When "Structure edge distance" is checked, structure starts must stay at least the given margin inside the statistics window (default 0). Results are capped at 4 chambers.
trial.pausingEta: Pausing: waiting for the current shard
trial.restartNotice: Search settings changed, so the checkpoint cannot resume; restarting from the beginning.
trial.truncated: Reached the per-seed limit of {limit}; results may be truncated.
trial.slowWarning: The chamber/spawner thresholds you entered are too low and will slow the search down. We recommend at least 3 trial chambers and 50 converted spawners. Do you want to adjust them?

geode.activityLegacy: 1.21.4-: circular tick radius, strict chunk-center circle
geode.rangeLargeHint: Large range: runtime increases noticeably; keep the automatic budget.
geode.help: The candidate budget is chosen automatically from the search range; values are in-model estimates, not in-game measurements. Whole-map searches only try the GPU coarse scan when "Allow GPU" is checked.
geode.fullMapSingleSeed: Full map search supports a single seed only.
geode.gpuFallback: GPU not used (only whole-map searches with a compatible OpenCL GPU use it; this run uses CPU)
geode.gpuNoOpencl: No usable OpenCL driver found; this run uses CPU
geode.gpuNoDevice: The GPU does not meet the OpenCL scan requirements (workgroup/local memory); this run uses CPU
geode.pausing: Pausing (waiting for the current work unit)
geode.stoppingEta: Stopping: waiting for the current work unit
geode.pausingEta: Pausing: waiting for the next checkpoint
